🚀 Travel Split v1.1.4 — Major Update
We've been working hard behind the scenes to make Travel Split more reliable and user-friendly. ❤️
🔔 New Notification Center
✅ Persistent notification read status
💬 Improved chat notifications
💰 Better expense & settlement tracking
📩 Improved group invitations
👤 Enhanced @username system
🔐 Improved data security
🔄 Better app update experience
🎨 UI & responsiveness improvements
🛠️ Multiple stability & calculation fixes
We're still actively developing and refining Travel Split.
Some advanced features are currently in initial stage while we continue improving them.

🚧 More improvements are coming soon!
📱 Play Store release coming soon.
